sections.content: transform moves/rotates/scales/skews elements without affecting layout: translate, rotate, scale, skew, matrix. transform-origin sets the pivot point.
3D transforms (rotateX/Y, perspective) add depth. Transforms combine by listing functions: transform: translateX(10px) rotate(45deg).
Key points: transforms are compositor-friendly, they do not trigger reflow, and percentage translates refer to the element's own size.
